edits.current: Contributory days for the occupational-risk subsystem.
edits.proposed: Contributory days for the occupational-risk subsystem on the 30-day commercial month. The occupational-risk days of all the lines reported for the same employee in the period add up to 30: a line that carries an SLN, IGE, LMA or VAC-LR event reports in this field the days of that event, and where the IRL day count (campo 30, T2R2-030) is greater than zero this field carries the same value. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) §2.1.2.3.13 campo 38.
edits.reason: HANDOFF-2026-10-16 section 3, PILA decision on campo 38 (ARL days add up to 30; SLN / IGE / LMA / VAC-LR lines report the days of the event; IRL > 0 same value), not yet applied.
